assessments.reasoning: Section 2.3.1 distinguishes runtime words from words executed by the parser. Its array-literal opening brace scans to a matching closing brace and builds an array. Its definition colon reads the effect and body to create a definition. The p.50 accumulator example reinforces the parse-time stage.

challenge.method: Compared parse-time execution with the distinct macro mechanism in §2.3.2, and checked the definition creation example and accumulator embodiment.
challenge.results: The two examples directly support the described parse-time class. The adjacent macro mechanism is separate, and no later parser semantics are inferred.

limitations: The examples concern the Factor forms described in 2010. Separate macros and later release implementation details remain outside this finding.
